responsibility: Implements the main expression-lowering visitor for the Rust backend, translating HIR expressions into GCC trees. It handles literals, tuple and array operations, calls, method dispatch, operator overloading, checked arithmetic in runtime contexts, blocks and control flow, field access, loops, pattern-driven match pieces, borrows/dereferences, closure construction, and Fn/FnMut/FnOnce call adaptation, combining type-checker results, autoderef adjustments, trait resolution, and backend expression builders to produce executable GCC IR trees.
same_name_distinction: Contains the main expression-lowering implementation, with visitor bodies for many HIR expression kinds plus concrete logic for overload resolution, closure generation, Fn-trait calls, and backend expression construction. Unlike the header, it is the large executable dispatcher for expression compilation rather than the declaration of that visitor and its helper methods.
